heightOn.description: Allow height changes: Off: /setheight is refused (sizes already set stay).

widthOn.description: Allow width changes: Off: /setwidth is refused and widths are drawn as normal.

minHeight.description: Smallest: The shortest a character can be made (0.85 = 15 % shorter).

maxHeight.description: Largest: The tallest a character can be made (1.1 = 10 % taller).

minWidth.description: Smallest: The thinnest a character can be made.

maxWidth.description: Largest: The widest a character can be made.

drawDistance.description: Drawn within: Other players' sizes are drawn this close; further away everyone looks normal (saves client time).

commandAccess.description: Who may use them: Everyone: each player changes only their own size, admins anyone's. Applies after the script restarts.
